name: io.github.benethos-hub/benethos-yahoo-finance-mcp
description: Unofficial read-only MCP server exposing Yahoo Finance data (via yfinance) over stdio or HTTP.

environmentVariables.name: YF_MCP_CACHE
environmentVariables.description: Cache results on disk with per-tool lifetimes, off by default.

environmentVariables.name: YF_MCP_CACHE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for the cache. Without it the operating system's user cache directory is used.

environmentVariables.name: YF_MCP_CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES
environmentVariables.description: Most results the cache keeps before it drops the oldest.

environmentVariables.name: YF_MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Detail of the log the server writes to stderr.
